description:
Set within the stunning private grounds of Holme Eden, this exceptional three-bedroom detached residence forms part of an exclusive courtyard development surrounded by picturesque countryside and neighbouring fields. Immaculately presented throughout, the property offers spacious, contemporary accommodation perfectly suited to modern family living.

The heart of the home is the stylish open-plan kitchen, dining and seating area, designed for both everyday life and entertaining. The high-gloss fitted kitchen features a breakfast bar, integrated dishwasher and wine cooler, while the generous living space provides a bright and welcoming environment. A separate lounge enjoys views over the attractive front gardens and benefits from a feature fireplace and French doors opening onto the rear garden.

Upstairs, the property offers three excellent double bedrooms, ensuring no compromise on space. The superb principal suite features fitted wardrobes, a dedicated dressing area and a modern en-suite shower room with vanity storage. The remaining bedrooms are served by a well-appointed family bathroom.

Externally, the low-maintenance rear garden has been thoughtfully landscaped with a patio and artificial lawn, creating the ideal space for outdoor dining and relaxation. A private garage, designated parking and additional visitor parking further enhance the practicality of this outstanding home.

Combining a peaceful countryside setting with beautifully presented accommodation throughout, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey home within one of the area's most desirable developments.

Directions Leave Carlisle on Warwick Road (A69) to the M6 motorway junction 43, taking the second exit onto A69 towards Brampton/Newcastle. Continue for approx. 4 miles, entering the village of Warwick Bridge. Take the left turn immediately before Little Corby Road, then left into the development.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
